verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no in-product feature that generates AI insights or suggestions from the user's own Workers data. Workers AI, AI Search and the Agents SDK are developer building blocks for constructing such features in your own apps. The managed MCP servers (e.g. Observability) let external MCP clients query account data, which is not an in-product insights experience. Built-in observability is described without any AI-generated insights.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
